sentences.en: It is costly and politically difficult to continue this conflict.
sentences.zh: 继续这场冲突既昂贵又在政治上困难。

sentences.en: It's not politically correct to make fun of someone's disability.
sentences.zh: 取笑别人的残疾是不正确的政治行为。

sentences.en: Those people are politically allies and will help each other.
sentences.zh: 那些人是政治盟友，会互相帮助。

senses.zh: 政治地；政党地政治上正确的(即言行不会冒犯特定人群)
